title: The Right Not to Be Saved
listing_description: A contrarian inquiry into cognitive sovereignty, selective help, and the danger of turning humanitarian knowledge or power into a license to override refusal.
reader_hook: Examine the closed door as a moral problem and ask when aid, education, intervention, and force respect agency or become their own kind of domination.
